sn48.51:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Kosalesu viharati sālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme || || 2.
sn48.51:1.3: Tatra kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi || pe [pa] || || 3.
sn48.51:1.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave ye keci tiracchānagatā pāṇā sīho migarājā tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idaṃ thāmena javena sūrena ||
sn48.51:1.5: evam eva kho bhikkhave ye keci bodhapakkhiyā dhammā paññindriyaṃ tesam aggam akkhāyati yad idam bodhāya || ||
sn48.51:2.2: Saddhiyindriyam bhikkhave bodhapakkhiyo dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati ||
sn48.51:2.3: Viriyindriyam bodhapakkhiyo dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati || ||
sn48.51:2.4: Satindriyam bodhapakkhiyo dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati ||
sn48.51:2.5: Samādhindriyam bodhapakkhiyo dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati || ||
sn48.51:2.6: Paññindriyam bodhapakkhiyo dhammo tam bodhāya saṃvattati || || 5.
